metadata.cache_condition: WARM OS page cache. No cold-cache measurement is made or claimed.
metadata.timing_notes: Only store calls are timed (one perf_counter_ns pair per operation); percentiles are nearest-rank (same code as V0..V4). The standard workload is bench.v4_run / bench.baseline_run run unchanged with KVStore substituted; the per-GET cache outcome (cache hit counter before and after the call) and the result checksum are recorded outside the timed interval. The replays, counters on SSTable._read_block and sstable._open_table, the V4-style structural sample, the retained-heap pass and the memory probes are untimed and run after (or between) the timed phases. open_recovery is the first KVStore(path) after close() in the same process, with an empty cache.
